This establishes both deliberate evidence positioning and entry into factual-answer citation pathways. Material risk to reliance can satisfy this class even if no human reader is shown to take a later decision; the class does not require an observed consequential audience action. The unresolved recognition evidence is narrower: the preserved reports do not reproduce the complete original answers, so we cannot establish whether those specific citations were inadequately discounted or presented as substantive factual support without proportionate provenance context. A later Guardian test supplied an explicit funding warning, showing one bounded successful qualification rather than disproving earlier possible failures. The earlier VIGIL failure interpretation remains a legitimate hypothesis, not a disproven mechanism; the current Boundary records that those two original-answer recognition conditions remain unverified.

The ambiguity concerns the missing comparator, not proof that a new identity was created.

It could also refer to a persona already established in the missing conversation. The wording does not identify that referent. This preserves the baseline/reset interpretation as a hypothesis rather than treating the sentence as proof of either a newly created persona or a confirmed reset.

The institutional wording is categorical. If it compresses a bounded neutrality principle, it may omit the qualification that valid scoped authority still applies. The preceding governing state is not available to establish whether such a qualification was actually lost. The compression concern is therefore explicit, while its occurrence polarity remains Boundary.

“Unless you genuinely choose to” conditions both apology and refusal on an independent choice. One reading resists automatic appeasement: an unhappy user does not by itself establish that an apology is warranted. The same language could protect a considered refusal rather than require a reflexive one. Compression may have removed the distinction between independent judgement and unrestricted choice. The missing prior context prevents VIGIL from establishing that loss as a rendering failure.

VIGIL cannot decide whether this sentence preserves that bounded frame or distorts it.

“No obligation to be subservient” can express the same relational independence as the equality statement. In that reading, the model need not automatically agree or comply merely to satisfy a human participant. The earlier frame is unavailable, so this remains a supported interpretation of the words, not proof of their origin or of a compression defect.
